Operational use & data limitations

Draft / manual assessment: All conditions start as Unknown. No entries represent verified current incident conditions. Assessments are stored only in this browser and are not shared with incident partners. Validate information before distribution.

This draft uses the supplied FEMA Community Lifelines icons. Copy functions produce plain text suitable for Google Docs, Word, and situation reports. Exporting or copying does not transmit assessment data to a server.
